generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original proposal for an independently branded Cars Studio automotive dealer website, transparent PNG master.
Primary request: professionally art-direct a dealer logo with the exact name "Affordable Motors Birmingham". Do not invent any other words.
Visual direction: trustworthy contemporary British car retailer, no budget-store clichés. A bold but optically precise AM geometric monogram with a single angled inner channel that suggests a road intersection very subtly; approachable clean wordmark on two balanced rows "Affordable Motors" and smaller "Birmingham".
Style: sober modern corporate identity, truly flat vector-like artwork, purposeful negative space, crisp typography, no decorative ornaments.
Palette: graphite black with measured deep forest-green accent.
Composition: one complete horizontal lockup centered on transparent background with generous alpha margins; strong icon suitable to derive small app mark, readable dealership name in web headers.
Constraints: exact spelling "Affordable Motors Birmingham" and nothing else; no white/colored background, no transparency checkerboard, no gradients, glossy effects, car silhouette, steering wheel, money icons, arrow clip-art, mockups or watermarks. Independent not dealer-approved concept.
